records.rationale: The description clearly describes a customer data platform and personalized marketing, but its claims to predict successful offers, channels, and future buying behavior do not resolve whether the mechanism is AI-dependent.

The description covers a registry web service that associates links and meaning with wireless identifiers, plus an SDK and a do-not-track registry, which are conventional registry and integration functions.
evidence_spans: a web service engine capable of associating links and meaning to detectable wireless names
